desc: 外盒与独立条包成套，撕袋倒水即冲即饮的高对比深色视觉
name: 随身条包电解质冲饮速溶款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，外盒与单条同框立住规格与剂型。
一秒讲清核心利益，深色场与强调色侧栏立住品牌感。
放大喝完一瓶白水仍不解渴的日常摩擦，引出条包方案。
用中性回环图解解释冲调机制，消除疑虑而不给断言。
把产品放进大量出汗的真实作业场景，让买家自我代入。
成排条包陈列让买家一次看全可选口味与盒装量感。
微距证明颗粒质地与一次一条的用法，去掉数字刻度。
用空白参数表与空印章框承接质检信任位，不搬任何数值。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF packshot stage alternating with a deep charcoal #17181A graphic field and one berry-pink #F07C85 infographic field, one full-height accent bar per dark screen
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line circular glyphs in one accent color, empty seal outlines, no filled pictograms and no cert or flag artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key front-left softbox key with a fill card, thin sweeping rim along sachet edges on dark fields, skimming texture light only on macro, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold high-contrast electrolyte drink-mix commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal #17181A, berry-pink accent #F07C85 and graphite text #33383D; bright high-key front-left softbox key with fill card, thin sweeping rim on dark fields and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in heavy uppercase; single-weight thin-line circular icon style with empty seal outlines; clean commercial food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable sachet angle and scale with blank label plates replacing every numeral; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no legible words, numbers or badges drawn in-frame
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or clean side-profile sachet angle and scale across the set, tear notch always readable, every parameter row rendered as a blank plate instead of a number
style.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal board #17181A, pale matte concrete #CFC7BE, low blank display tray on seamless white #FFFFFF, loose granule scatter as the only surface texture
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in heavy uppercase display scale, in-image copy carried only by placeholders, never dense body text
